headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawJoinedStep_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit : ℕ)
      (word : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.uniformStepWidth r c U L N hIn J hExit) → Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawJoinedStep (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L N hIn J hExit
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑d) (List.ofFn word) =
        Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L
          ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.uniformJoinedWord r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit word)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawJoinedWalk_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit T : ℕ)
      (word : Fin (T * Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.uniformStepWidth r c U L N hIn J hExit) → Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawJoinedWalk (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L N hIn J hExit T
          (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑start) (List.ofFn word) =
        Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L
          ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.joinedWalkWord r c U L hr hc start N hIn J hExit T word)
